about: The prices autopilot/estimate.py uses for `autopilot estimate` and `play --estimate`. Update a price here when the provider changes it, and set its `checked` date. Each price is USD per million tokens.

anthropic.note: cache_write is the 5-minute cache write (1.25 x input). fast: the price multiplier of fast mode (Opus only).

typesafe.note: TypeSafe has no pricing page. The homepage and the secondary source give 0.042 USD per million input tokens; output is free. Models match by prefix (jev-1.13.0 uses jev).

aura.basis: Run 20261107-165445 (renderatl-rush, claude on claude-opus-5-5 fast, 2 episodes): Aura billed 3.06 USD. The same tokens at the own-key prices above cost about 3.20 USD. Aura credits = own-key total x factor. Replace the factor when more Aura bills are known.

priors.about: Used when a project has no earlier run with cost data. From run 20261107-165445, with the range set to about 0.5x to 2x of that run. A unit is one million input tokens at the model's input price (cache and output tokens included at their price ratio).
